comparison.objective: Hold a slack cord taut and cut it safely with a knife.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually tension a flexible cord while applying sustained blade force at a safe distance from the holding hand.
comparison.success_condition: Cord severed while held, cut at least 5 cm from holding pads and 3 cm from anchor, no blade contact with grippers/table, knife released safely.
comparison.reason: Both create a separated piece, but this tests tension-assisted blade cutting of a cord. It does not test hammer impulse through a coaxial mandrel, notch fracture, retained-insert protection, or collection of four fragments.
